jobs.name: ig36_cover
jobs.person_note: The SAME man as in the attached photo: same face, full dark beard, olive bomber jacket over black hoodie; do not change his face shape.
jobs.style: A finished, minimal, eye-catching vertical Instagram Reels COVER on a pure black background. Bold, clean, perfectly spelled Russian typography is REQUIRED. No logos, no watermarks, no UI elements.
jobs.style_qa: обложка: чёрный фон, сверху надписи «100 РАЗ ПОМОЖЕШЬ — ЗАБУДУТ» и «1 РАЗ ОТКАЖЕШЬ — ЗАПОМНЯТ» без ошибок, ниже горизонтальный кадр с тем же мужчиной за рулём ночью; других слов и логотипов нет
jobs.prompt: Vertical 9:16 cover, solid pure black background. In the UPPER part, between 18% and 45% of the image height, centered: huge bold white sans-serif uppercase text in four short lines: «100 РАЗ ПОМОЖЕШЬ —» / «ЗАБУДУТ» / «1 РАЗ ОТКАЖЕШЬ —» / «ЗАПОМНЯТ», the words «ЗАБУДУТ» in white and «ЗАПОМНЯТ» in warm golden yellow. Below the text, between 50% and 80% of the height, a horizontal 16:9 photo panel spanning the full width: the man from the reference sits in the driver seat of a car at night, looking straight into the camera, serious, warm city lights through the side window. Rest of the frame stays pure black. No other text.
